title: Direct Salts Blueberry Sour Raspberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Direct Salts Blueberry Sour Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid delivers a bold and intensely tangy fruit experience. The profile opens with the mellow, familiar sweetness of ripe Blueberry, laying down a rich and juicy foundation. This is immediately met by a sharp and acidic wave of Sour Raspberry on the exhale. This contrasting berry profile delivers a dynamic and thoroughly engaging vape from start to finish. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Direct Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Direct Salts collection offers vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and confectionery profiles. Providing a highly cost-effective and flexible option, this 10ml range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the bold tang of Blueberry Sour Raspberry, vapers can explore other compelling options such as the classic Cherry Cola, the exotic Fruity Juice, or the crisp Pineapple Ice.
